name: chirp
description: Microsoft Teams chats and channels in a sidebar of their own, each conversation an editor tab, with its text available to the AI agent beside it. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

commands.title: chirp: Copy the Admin Approval Link
chirp: Copy Sign-in Code and Open the Sign-in Page

enumDescriptions: A token file if one is set, otherwise the editor's Microsoft sign-in, otherwise a sign-in code.
The editor's own Microsoft account sign-in, using chirp's app.
A code you enter at microsoft.com/devicelogin; chirp keeps the tokens in the editor's secret storage.
Reuse the login another tool keeps in a token file (chirp.signIn.tokenFile).
chirp.signIn.method.description: How chirp signs in to Microsoft. See the README's "Signing in" section.

chirp.signIn.tokenFile.description: A token file another tool keeps (JSON with access_token, refresh_token, client_id, tenant_id, expires_at). When set, chirp reuses that login instead of signing in itself. chirp refreshes it in place and never deletes it.

chirp.agentFiles.description: Write each open conversation to ~/.chirp as plain text (files readable only by you), so an AI agent beside chirp knows which chat is open. Off: no files, and chirp.activeConversationFile returns nothing.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js media/*.js test/*.js; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
